source: 7A: 1303 cc four-cylinder, 32 PS (23.5 kW); three-speed gearbox with the lever through the dashboard; about 95 km/h (Wikipedia; Stellantis media; motor1). Assumed: rated at 3200 rpm with a droop to 3400 rpm no-load, ratios 3.0/1.7/1.0 with a 4.4 final drive (top gear 93 km/h at rated speed, 99 km/h no-load), the drum capacities.
brake_note: Hydraulic brakes on all four drums (sourced): the pedal works all four, 300 N m at each front drum and 220 N m at each rear, 1040 N m in all, about 0.31 g on level ground. The hand lever works the rear drums only (assumed).
